name: Cursed Underoak
source:
A curse for a wish granted. Will the other Cursed help you, or will you find your own way to break it, no matter what it takes?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
一个愿望得以实现，代价是一道诅咒。其他受诅咒的人会帮你吗？还是说，无论付出什么代价，你都会自己找到破解它的办法？

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]］
